epics.name: 專案設置
epics.definition: Project skeleton: Prisma schema + RDS, NextAuth.js, design system formalization, env config. Must complete before any functional Epic.

stories.name: 環境變數與金鑰設定
stories.definition: .env.example, secret storage convention, AWS credential placeholders

stories.name: 核心資料模型
stories.definition: Prisma schema (User, Course, Registrant, Organization, Instructor, Admin), migrations, seed script

stories.name: 認證框架
stories.definition: NextAuth.js v5 setup, JWT sessions, login page → real auth, registration endpoint, role-based middleware

stories.name: UI 設計系統
stories.definition: 5-stage design process: S1 framework → S2 style tile → S3 design tokens → S4 component library → S5 page layouts. Persisted to ai/context/design-system.md

epics.name: 課程管理
epics.definition: Course CRUD from database, catalog/search/filter, course detail with real data

stories.name: 課程 API
stories.definition: GET courses (filtered), GET course/[slug] (with relations), POST/PATCH/DELETE (admin)

stories.name: 課程目錄頁
stories.definition: Fetch courses from API instead of inline mock data, search/filter wired to real data

stories.name: 課程詳情頁
stories.definition: Fetch single course from API with syllabus, instructors, schedules, reviews, FAQs

stories.name: 課程 syllabus 下載手冊
stories.definition: GET /api/courses/[slug]/brochure endpoint that generates downloadable HTML brochure from DB course + syllabus items; wire existing buttons in CourseCard and CourseDetailView

epics.name: 報名與結帳
epics.definition: Enrollment API, individual + group registration, multi-course checkout, payment proof upload

stories.name: 報名 API
stories.definition: POST /api/enroll — validate course availability, check capacity, create registrant, handle group enrollment

stories.name: 個人報名流程
stories.definition: Wire 3-step wizard to real submission, redirect to confirmation with registrant ID

stories.name: 團體報名表單
stories.definition: Individual/Organization toggle, multi-registrant dynamic form, running total calculation

stories.name: 付款證明上傳
stories.definition: S3 presigned URL upload, file type/size validation, AES256 encryption, DB update with proof URL

epics.name: 金流與收據
epics.definition: S3 upload, admin verification, PDF receipt generation, SES email delivery

stories.name: 管理員審核後台
stories.definition: Real DB enrolments in admin table, payment proof image preview (presigned S3 URL), approve/reject actions

stories.name: PDF 電子收據生成
stories.definition: @react-pdf/renderer receipt template, generate + store in S3, pdf-lib password lock, auto receipt number

stories.name: SES 郵件自動發送
stories.definition: nodemailer + SES transport, bilingual email template (ZH+EN), PDF attachment, triggered on admin approval

epics.name: 內容與靜態頁面
epics.definition: i18n migration for static pages, contact page, bug fixes, content fill

stories.name: 條款與隱私頁 i18n
stories.definition: Migrate terms, privacy pages to use dictionary system with all 3 locales

stories.name: 關於我們頁 i18n
stories.definition: Migrate about page to dictionary system, add real content (我們是誰、我們的服務、我們的課程)

stories.name: 聯絡我們頁
stories.definition: New contact page: map embed, phone, email, WhatsApp links, i18n dictionary

stories.name: Bug 修復與重構
stories.definition: Fix CourseSyllabus duplicate, enrolments placeholder duplicate, locale prefix missing in links, remove alert() calls

epics.name: UI-Consistency-Fixes
epics.definition: Frontend UI consistency pass: fix footer nav links, refresh color palette (Variant C), replace hero images, redesign newsletter banner to consultation CTA, add breadcrumbs to public pages, redesign contact page typography/map

stories.name: 導航與頁面修復
stories.definition: Footer redirect path fixes, breadcrumbs on 6 public pages

stories.name: 視覺與色票更新
stories.definition: CSS :root token refresh to Variant C (Rich Jewel), Hero overlay & Newsletter background to brand emerald

stories.name: 首頁區域重新設計
stories.definition: Newsletter→consultation CTA banner, hero carousel image replacement

stories.name: 聯絡頁 UI 改版
stories.definition: Font family/size refresh, map aspect-square, add breadcrumbs

epics.name: 第二階段：學員與講師功能
epics.definition: Phase 2: student dashboard, instructor dashboard, certificates, online payment, recorded video, chatbot. DEPENDS ON: all Phase 1 Epics complete

stories.name: 學員會員中心
stories.definition: Enrolment history, receipt download, certificate access, profile management

stories.name: 講師後台
stories.definition: Class roster view, upload course materials, attendance tracking

stories.name: 自動化證書
stories.definition: Auto-generate PDF certificate on course completion, unique anti-forgery ID, S3 storage

stories.name: 線上支付
stories.definition: Stripe/PayPal integration for credit card, Alipay online payment

stories.name: 聊天機器人
stories.definition: Deterministic FAQ QnA first, Microsoft Foundry AI integration later

epics.name: 基礎設施
epics.definition: Production infrastructure: RDS Proxy, VPC networking, secure database connectivity without public exposure, CI/CD deployment pipeline for Amplify

stories.name: RDS Proxy 資料庫安全連線
stories.definition: Replace 0.0.0.0/0 with RDS Proxy; Lambda connects via IAM auth through private AWS network. Record failed VPC + SG attempt.

stories.name: Amplify 正式環境佈署
stories.definition: CI/CD with amplify.yml, env var injection, health check API, database migration strategy on deploy

epics.name: 管理員後台 Redesign
epics.definition: Phase 1: comprehensive admin dashboard redesign covering UI refresh, functional improvements (enrolment management, course CRUD, user management), and full i18n (en, zh-hk, zh-cn). Replaces mock data with real API on all admin pages.

stories.name: Admin UI 重新設計
stories.definition: Visual redesign of admin dashboard, enrolment table, course management views, user management — consistent with institutional slate/emerald design system

stories.name: Admin 功能補強
stories.definition: Course CRUD from admin, user management (view/edit users), enrolment filtering/search, batch approve/reject

stories.name: Admin 多語介面
stories.definition: i18n dictionary for all admin pages: en, zh-hk, zh-cn

epics.name: 資訊安全
epics.definition: Security audit and hardening for the entire platform: dependency vulnerabilities, auth boundary review, data encryption, API security, infrastructure security posture.

stories.name: 資安基礎檢查
stories.definition: Initial security scan: npm audit, dependency review, hardcoded secrets, auth boundary mapping, CSP headers, rate limiting, S3 bucket permissions, SSL/TLS configuration
